_comments.hook_chain: PostToolUse hooks run in order. If spec-gate.sh exits 1 (no spec found), Claude Code aborts the hook chain and the Edit/Write is blocked — subsequent hooks (format-lint, explain-diff, token-budget-warn) do NOT run. Exit 0 passes through to the next hook.
_comments.decisions: Decisions are captured manually via /session-wrap at end of session — no Stop hook overhead on every turn.
